name: Reward Ledger
summary: Computes reward progress from active time and counted equals, persists claim state, and redeems ready local tiers.
critical_flows: count source equals once per batch
persist earned tier and reward setting state
known_gaps: README describes backend claim flow for valuable rewards, but no backend implementation exists in this repository.

evidence.reason: Defines default reward settings, progress computation, milestone statuses, redemption, and announcement state.
Owns per-project equals ledger normalization, idempotent batch counting, totals, and project cleanup.
Defines reward tiers and display milestones consumed by reward logic and setup text.
